Theorem
Source: topping:page-0053 1. ch3:3.3\group maximum-principle Let $g(t)$ be a Ricci flow on a boundaryless, not necessarily complete manifold $U$ for $t\in [0,T]$. If $|\Rm |\leq M$ on $U\times [0,T]$, $p\in U$, $r>0$, and $B_{g(0)}(p,r)\subset U$, then \[ |\nabla \Rm (p,T)|^2\leq C(n)M^2 \left(\frac1{r^2}+\frac1T+M\right). \]
